title: A heptanuclear heterotrimetallic cluster exhibiting single-molecule magnet behavior

synthesis.procedure: To a mixture of 0.1 mL of 2 M aqueous Tb(ClO4)3 (0.2 mmol), 0.053 g CrCl3·6H2O (0.2 mmol), 0.118 g maleic acid (1.2 mmol) and 2 mL deionized water, 0.1 M aqueous NaOH was added dropwise to adjust the pH to ~6.7. After 30 minutes of stirring, the mixture was filtered. Well-formed red crystals suitable for X-ray analysis were obtained by slow evaporation of the filtrate for a few days. The product was collected and washed with acetone (3 × 5 mL) and diethyl ether (3 × 5 mL).

reagents.name: terbium(III) perchlorate
reagents.amount: 0.1 mL of 2 M aqueous solution (0.2 mmol)

reagents.name: sodium hydroxide
reagents.amount: 0.1 M aqueous solution, added dropwise to pH ~6.7

synthesis.time: 30 minutes stirring; crystals by slow evaporation for a few days
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered after stirring; red crystals grown by slow evaporation of the filtrate; washed with acetone (3 × 5 mL) and diethyl ether (3 × 5 mL).

properties.summary: Compound 1 shows overall ferromagnetic Cr–Tb and/or Tb–Tb interactions and slow magnetic relaxation consistent with SMM behavior. χMT increases on cooling; magnetization at 2 K/7 T is close to the expected saturation value; frequency-dependent out-of-phase ac susceptibility rises near 3 K, but no χ″ maximum is reached down to 1.8 K at 1200 Hz.

measurements.name: χMT
measurements.conditions: room temperature; polycrystalline sample; 2 kOe (0.1 T) dc field; 2.0–300 K range

measurements.name: χMT
measurements.conditions: maximum at around 2.0 K; 2 kOe dc field

measurements.name: out-of-phase ac susceptibility χ″
measurements.value: frequency-dependent increase near 3.0 K; no maximum observed down to 1.8 K at 1200 Hz
measurements.conditions: 1.8–10 K; 50–1200 Hz; 3.5 Oe ac field; zero dc field
